# 使用帮助与反馈

这里接收 Testany Agent Skills 仓库中所有插件的反馈：testany-eng、testany-llm、testany-mrkt、testany-bot 和 SkillDock。中文和 English 都欢迎。

| 你需要什么 | 去哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| 不知道怎么安装或使用 | [Discussions · Q&A](https://github.com/TestAny-io/testany-agent-skills/discussions/categories/q-a) |
| 有建议，或想说说试用体验 | [Discussions · Ideas](https://github.com/TestAny-io/testany-agent-skills/discussions/categories/ideas) |
| 分享一个工作流或使用成果 | [Discussions · Show and tell](https://github.com/TestAny-io/testany-agent-skills/discussions/categories/show-and-tell) |
| 发现可以复现的故障 | [提交 Bug](https://github.com/TestAny-io/testany-agent-skills/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml) |

求助时先说“使用哪个插件、想做什么、实际发生了什么”。如果方便，再补充系统 / Codex 或 Claude Code 版本、插件版本、安装方式和一张截图；不确定的信息可以留空。

试用 SkillDock 后，可以直接复制这三行到 Ideas：

```text
安装并打开：顺利 / 卡在……
最有用的功能：……
最困惑或最希望改进的地方：……
```

附截图或日志前，请去掉 token、私仓凭据和不想公开的路径或项目内容。需要私下沟通时，可联系 [engineering@testany.io](mailto:engineering@testany.io)。

安装入口：[仓库首页](../README.md) · [SkillDock](../plugins/skilldock/README.md)。想了解 Testany 平台，访问 [testany.io](https://testany.io)。

## English

Feedback is welcome for every plugin in this repository, in English or Chinese.

- [Q&A](https://github.com/TestAny-io/testany-agent-skills/discussions/categories/q-a): installation and usage help.
- [Ideas](https://github.com/TestAny-io/testany-agent-skills/discussions/categories/ideas): suggestions and trial feedback.
- [Show and tell](https://github.com/TestAny-io/testany-agent-skills/discussions/categories/show-and-tell): workflows and things you made.
- [Bug report](https://github.com/TestAny-io/testany-agent-skills/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml): reproducible failures.

Start with the plugin, what you wanted to do, and what happened. If available, add your OS / agent version, plugin version, installation method, and a screenshot. Unknown details can be left blank.

For SkillDock, a short note about installation, the most useful feature, and the most confusing step is especially helpful. Remove credentials, private repository tokens, and private project details from screenshots or logs. For private correspondence, use [engineering@testany.io](mailto:engineering@testany.io).

[Get started](../README.en.md) · [SkillDock](../plugins/skilldock/README.en.md) · [Meet Testany](https://testany.io).
